Chapter 6264: Crimson Abyssal Hellflame Metal

Chapter 6264: Crimson Abyssal Hellflame Metal

Li Qiye smiled while observing the incoming cauldron before blowing the wisp of flame in his other hand.

"Poof." The power of the tribulation flame manifested into reality, incinerating anything found at the imperial level.

The fire-attuned emperor understood what he was facing and shifted to a defensive stance, moving the cauldron to the front.

"Rumble!" It opened in an attempt to suck in the tribulation flames. He thought he could at least contain this wisp since the cauldron was crafted with all his might using Crimson Abyssal Hellflame Metal.

It was born from a flame with the same name, capable of withstanding imperial, sin, or other types... Because of it, the emperor was able to gather and contain flames.

Although it might be able to withstand the dao flame of a stronger cultivator, it glowed red after taking in the wisp of tribulation flame.

Cracks appeared and it started melting. This scared the hell out of the emperor.

Li Qiye didn't give him a second glance and sent tribulation flames into Frost Emperor's neck.

"Ahh!" She suffered the same phenomenon as the great tree - having fissures with embers glowing beneath.

This was more agonizing than the cruelest torture method. Tears streamed down her cheeks as her body burned down.

"Would you like to be a servant permanently or turn to ashes?" Li Qiye asked with a smile.

The scene of the nine-fruit emperor bellowing in pain shocked and suffocated the crowd.

"Death!" She didn't yield.

"Very well, have it your way." Li Qiye said before she ignited entirely in flames.

"Ahh!" The pain increased tenfold; her screams echoed.

Another emperor screamed at the same time - Crimson Cauldron. His cauldron endured countless flames in the past so he thought it couldn't be destroyed.

Alas, it had turned to molten liquid, leaving him vulnerable. He evaded with an extraordinary movement technique but couldn't escape the wisp.

The moment it chose him as a target, it would always be there. The stronger Frost stood no chance, let alone him. Thus, he screamed just like her during the fiery ignition.

Everyone had goosebumps while listening to the two wailing emperors.

"Stop!" A voice came from the portal above, engulfing the myriad realms. Even emperors feared it.

"The primal ancestor!" Everyone knew the speaker's cultivation.

"Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!" Three emperors descended, drawing their weapons and attacking Li Qiye without saying a word.

Their supreme grand dao suppressed everything; their fury crushed all things.

"Looks like we're having a feast of roast emperors." Li Qiye smiled and gently waved.

"Boom!" More flames violently surged out of the tree and overwhelmed the three newcomers.

They immediately tried to protect themselves but couldn't handle the endless waves.

None expected the tree to crumble, releasing all of the tribulation flames.
